name: - TINU
fix_description: In deliver(), add a maximum limit on tAmount to prevent single-transaction manipulation of _rTotal. Same reflection token vulnerability as FDP and BEVO.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step DeFi interaction involving a flash loan, fee-on-transfer/reflection token mechanics, pair balance distortion via deliver(), skim abuse, and then draining value from the Uniswap pair. The PoC is still fairly short, but understanding why reflection accounting breaks AMM assumptions requires protocol-specific reasoning beyond a simple access-control or vanilla reentrancy bug.
